1 · Intro

When to use it.

A service free stipend pays a student a stipend when the student performs no services in return.

The hire reason Service free appointment is only for students receiving a stipend. This setup needs no I-9 and no background check.

Use this whenA student will receive a stipend and will not perform any work or services for it.

2 · Walk through

What to know.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Using Service free appointment for a student who works creates an employee with no I-9. That is a compliance gap.
  • Federal wage guidance (DOL Fact Sheet #17S) treats some stipend situations as non-employment, but the facts decide. Do not make that call yourself.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's assignment status, element, costing account, and tax handling for service free stipends are not yet documented.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: How You Convert Pending Workers (opens in a new tab)
  • DOL: Fact Sheet #17S (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Students

Service Free Stipend

Use when: A student will receive a stipend and will not perform any work or services for it. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Confirm the student performs no services for the stipend.
    • Any services for pay: not service free
  2. Search the student in Our Workforce > Employment Info.
  3. Use hire reason Service free appointment when you hire or convert.
  4. Skip the I-9 and background check.
  5. Submit and confirm the record and end date.

Watch-outs

  • Using Service free appointment for a student who works creates an employee with no I-9. That is a compliance gap.
  • Federal wage guidance (DOL Fact Sheet #17S) treats some stipend situations as non-employment, but the facts decide. Do not make that call yourself.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's assignment status, element, costing account, and tax handling for service free stipends are not yet documented.
